notes: Main text occupies approximately 23 physical lines, with raised additions; the upper cancelled note has about six oblique lines and the lower live note about seven. The authorial number 17 is at the top and thin foliation 34 at bottom left. The page continues a discussion of the inverse image of x in the universal abelian covering and asserts triviality only for x=0; it then discusses characteristic p, radicial parts and the proétale quotient. It says the prime-to-p fundamental-group formulation has a counterexample already for an elliptic curve, made anabelian by removing a point. These are statements reported from the page, not independently proved here. Therefore check_events is empty. Main corrections against C are rév. with visible accent, G(n) simeq G, a locally doubtful des|de, four resolved supplied doubts, and improved reading/punctuation of the lower note. H has substantial word omissions and relocates multiple insertions. The H subscript has a joined arch that by itself admits n: H_1 is the witnesses’ and established notation reading reported by the main reader; both survive as 1|n in the page. The paired terminal strokes after raised texte may be quotes or part of the leader, and no unseen opening quote is supplied. Uncertain cancelled letters, the lower note abbreviation stop, au cas and l’aise/l’air remain marked. The lower note’s en se remplaçant is retained despite awkward grammar; no algebraic correction or missing word is supplied. Initial and repeated quotations use literal paired double marks. No OCR, external research, other-page witness/image inspection or TeX compilation was used. The main reader added an extra blind-reading box for the tiny initial accent, despite the first reading being high confidence.
